name: @agentic-toolkit/messaging
description: Direct messages and notifications for agentic-web-toolkit consumers — authed SSE-backed hooks over the backend's DM/notification API, plus the DM list/thread/panel, notification bell/inbox and presence-dot components.
comment:exports: `development` → src for `next dev` (HMR, no build/restart); prod (NODE_ENV=production) skips it → dist. Self-degrading if the bundler ignores it. See @agentic-toolkit/adh for the full rationale. `./sources.css` is the Tailwind @source self-registration a host @imports once. `./hooks/*` resolves .ts and `./components/*` .tsx — an exports map has no extension fallback, so tsup's entry globs must name exactly these two extensions and no others.
